semantics.precision_scope: Every native plot vertex is transformed once with the recorded PROJ operation and rounded to seven decimals. Plot 200A of plan 632-0649806 is bound to the campus by the issuer's own plot references; it is a planning plot, not a surveyed cadastral boundary, building footprint or current work extent. The display anchor is the planar shoelace centroid of the transformed ring, verified inside it.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The planning service states no positional accuracy and disclaims official status; the 0.5 m datum-operation figure is not a plot accuracy.
